findings.evidence: The opened F2 target, lem-cylinder-premeasure-from-consistent-finite-dimensional-laws-is-well-defined, concerns defining a finitely additive cylinder law; it does not establish that a probability-kernel section has a nonempty target. Nonemptiness follows immediately from the statement’s probability-kernel hypothesis, so this is a nonfatal citation defect. Cite the kernel condition K_n(x,E_{n+1})=1.
